title: Tighten the shared test-ref bullet: parent on origin/master, not a landing, explicit deletion refspec
outcome: The test-ref bullet in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (and Engram's twin) says three things. (1) The test commit's parent must be reachable from origin/master at push time, so a push never publishes unpushed master commits. (2) A test-ref commit and push are not landings: the master pre-push checks and commit condition 2 don't apply to them. (3) The exact refspec allowed for deleting the ref. The amended wording is concurred by both projects' coordinators and lands under the authority-text rule.
acceptance: Both coordinators (Termal::Fable2, Engram::Fable) concur on exact amended wording that covers all three points, and it is recorded on this item.
The amended bullet lands byte-identically in TermAl's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md under the authority-text rule (Greg notified, final-diff audit passed); Engram's twin is landed or tracked there.
